column1: # BREmote V2.5-Evo RX custom partition table (4 MB ESP32-C3 HT-CT62)
# V2.5-Evo - 2026-07-14 - No-OTA single-app layout: 2.0 MB app slot + 1.875 MB SPIFFS.
# Rationale: OTA is intentionally dropped (RX is flashed over USB)
# OTA app slot from default.csv is reclaimed. Split gives ~730 KB app headroom for FM-mode
# future work AND a larger SPIFFS than the old default (1.375 MB) for on-board VESC logging.
# Offsets sum exactly to 0x400000 (4 MB). SPIFFS is located by label
# filesystem re-formats on first mount after reflash (expected: wipes settings
